description: Human Resource Management System v4.2 (Build 2024.03.15) — Oracle Forms 12c client-server monolith on a single Oracle Database HRMS schema. Covers employee lifecycle, payroll, leave, performance management, reporting, and external integrations.

applications.name: HRMS Oracle Forms Client
applications.framework: Oracle Forms 12c (12.2.1.4) — Java applet served via Oracle WebLogic/Forms Services

evidence.reason: Oracle Forms Builder 12c (12.2.1.4) header; form binary HRMS_LOGIN.fmb
